subject: Risk & Compliance
title: Scenario Analysis for Op Risk
description: One-minute skill: Scenario Analysis for Op Risk.

hook.text: What if your data center burns down? What if a rogue trader hides $5 billion? Scenario analysis imagines the worst.

buildup.text: Scenario analysis models extreme but plausible events to test whether the organization could survive them.

discovery.text: Banks use scenarios to calculate how much capital they need to absorb operational risk losses.

twist.text: The best scenarios come from combining historical events with creative 'what if' thinking about future threats.

climax.text: Scenario analysis bridges the gap between what has happened and what could happen. It stretches imagination.

punchline.text: Imagine the worst. Plan for it. Hope you never need the plan.

quiz.question: What is the purpose of scenario analysis in operational risk?
options: Testing if the organization could survive extreme but plausible events
